# GXO Innovation Tour 2026


## Experience the future of automation at our next Innovation Tour in the Netherlands! ​


Get an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at our operations through a **site tour** of one of our most innovative facilities. ​


Stay ahead of the curve with insights on the latest trends and innovations and dive into inspiring **keynotes** on **AI, innovation** and **automation** .​


⁠Join us for a day of inspiration, exchange, and forward-thinking ideas – connect with our ecosystem and discover new opportunities for what’s next.​


**Location:** GXO site, in Almere, Netherlands​


**Date & Time:** 30 September, 10:00 – 16:00 ​


## Apply now to attend GXO’s Innovation Tour in Almere, Netherlands on 30 September


## ****Your exclusive access to innovation** ​**


****Don’t miss out – here’s why:​****


- Exclusive site tour at a cutting-edge facility​
- Get inspired by our keynotes on AI and technology ​
- Engage with industry leaders and decision-makers from across the industry​
- Explore the future of logistics and automation​
- Grow your network and get valuable connections​

## Agenda


10:00 – 10:30 Registration and Welcome Reception


10:30 – 11:00 **Opening Speech**


11:00 – 11:40


**Keynote** The GXO Way: Turning Innovation into Performance at Scale


*How GXO translates innovation, automation, and AI into measurable operational performance and customer value. Featuring a guest contribution on AI and the future of intelligent logistics operations.*


11:40 – 13:00 Networking Lunch


13:00 – 13:30


**Inspirational Keynote** The Future of AI in Logistics


*From intelligent agents to self-learning supply chains, trendwatcher and futurist Richard van Hooijdonk reveals the AI trends reshaping logistics and shows how to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change by becoming an AI-first organization.*


13:30 – 15:15 ****


**“Site Visit:”** Guided Site Tour & Live Automation


*Experience GXO innovation in action through an exclusive tour of the Hunkemöller operation. Discover how automation, robotics, and AI are transforming logistics through live demonstrations of industry-leading technologies and how GXO delivers operational excellence at scale.*


15:15 – 16:00 Networking


## Hotel recommendation


****Van der Valk Hotel Almere**** , Veluwezoom 45, 1327 AK Almere, Netherlands


Located approximately 15 minutes by car from the GXO Innovation Tour venue.


For attendees arriving late at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, we also recommend: Hilton Amsterdam Airport Schiphol
